$comment: A Salt for WordPress site with a map integration: maps, WordPress's own consent category, maps to the WP Consent API's marketing (SC-030), so the marketing box covers embeds, maps and marketing, and the panel still draws two boxes. The rest is consent-panel-open.
summary: The consent panel open on a WordPress site with maps: two boxes, statistics and marketing, the marketing box setting embeds, maps and marketing together.

categories.label: Analytics
categories.description: Helps us see which pages are read, with no personal details.

categories.label: Marketing and embedded content
categories.description: Lets us measure how our adverts perform, and shows videos and maps from other sites, our own map included.
